description: Generated by `cargo xtask capability-map` from docs/architecture/capability-map.json. Each property is one AlasConfig field; x-alas carries the unit, level and hidden flag from the inventory.

autobalance_alpha_high_deg.description: Higher alpha of the two-point pair used to estimate the Cm-Cl slope during autobalance.

autobalance_alpha_low_deg.description: Lower alpha of the two-point pair used to estimate the Cm-Cl slope during autobalance.

autobalance_velocity_m_s.description: Airspeed used for the autobalance neutral-point probe (finds the CG that gives the target static margin).

avl_timeout_s.description: Wall-clock deadline for final AVL sweeps; independent of the optimizer candidate budget and aerodynamic mesh.

chordwise_resolution.description: Chordwise vortex-lattice panels per strip for the fast in-loop estimate (a count, not a multiplier). 1 reduces the section to a flat plate; 8 is converged.

compressible_trim.description: Solve trim and the polar on the Goethert/Prandtl-Glauert stretched lattice at the cruise Mach.

fine_chordwise_resolution.description: Chordwise panels for the once-per-run final analysis. A supercritical section needs about 8 to resolve its camber; convergence is first order, so 16 is better.

fine_spanwise_resolution.description: Spanwise panel resolution for the once-per-run final analysis only (polar, trimmed cruise, neutral point). Leave at 1: the span is already converged.

include_fuselage_stability.description: Whether to include the geometry-driven fuselage (Munk/Multhopp) destabilising contribution, which moves the neutral point forward.

polar_fit_cl_max.description: Upper CL bound of the primary drag-polar fit window.

polar_fit_cl_max_fallback.description: Wider fallback upper CL bound used when the primary fit window captures fewer than 3 points.

x-alas.label: Drag-polar fit fallback window: CL maximum

polar_fit_cl_min.description: Lower CL bound of the window used to fit the parabolic drag polar (CD = CD0 + k*CL^2). Points outside the window are excluded so stall/pre-stall regions don't bias the fit.

polar_fit_cl_min_fallback.description: Wider fallback lower CL bound used when the primary fit window captures fewer than 3 points.

x-alas.label: Drag-polar fit fallback window: CL minimum

probe_alpha_high_deg.description: Higher of the two-point fast-probe alpha pair.

probe_alpha_low_deg.description: Lower of a two-point alpha pair used for a fast in-loop lift-slope/stability estimate (not the full sweep).

spanwise_resolution.description: Multiplier on each surface's built-in spanwise vortex-lattice panel count. Leave at 1; values above 2 are rejected. Part of the Fidelity preset.

sweep_alpha_max_deg.description: Highest angle of attack evaluated in the final high-fidelity polar sweep.

sweep_alpha_min_deg.description: Lowest angle of attack evaluated in the final high-fidelity polar sweep.

sweep_n_points.description: How many angle-of-attack points to evaluate between the min/max alpha. More points = smoother drag polar, slower analysis. Part of the Fidelity preset.

tail_efficiency.description: Ratio of the tail's dynamic pressure to the free stream's (dimensionless); tail lift and moment scale with it. Unset: empirical 0.78 (NASA CR-2144, TN D-3797).

trim_incidence_probe_delta_deg.description: Small horizontal-stabilizer incidence perturbation [deg] used to estimate dCL/di_h and dCm/di_h for the closed-form trim solve. 0.5-2 deg is typical.

arrival_airport.description: Arrival aerodrome, by display name. Together with the departure aerodrome this fixes the range the mission is flown over and the landing field length that has to be met.

aft_door_x_m.description: Longitudinal position of the aft lower-hold door. 0 places it against the aft hold.

baggage_policy.description: How checked baggage is split between hold compartments: 'target_cg' trims toward the balance target, 'volume_proportional' splits by compartment volume.

cg_trim_max_iterations.description: Iteration cap for the CG trim. A very large aircraft with small steps may need more than the default; raise this rather than the step if the trim does not converge.

cg_trim_step_kg.description: How much payload the centre-of-gravity trim moves between positions per iteration. A smaller step trims more precisely and needs more iterations to get there.

freight_hold.description: Declared freight hold (floor, ramp, clear width and height) of a military transport or freighter.

fwd_door_x_m.description: Longitudinal position of the forward lower-hold door. 0 places it against the forward hold.

hold_compartments.description: Declared baggage compartments with station extent, volume and optional net-mass limit. Empty means the compartments are derived from the fuselage geometry.

loading_strategy.description: How to place the load: 'target_cg' trims to the target CG, 'min_pallets' concentrates full containers, 'door_proximity' favours doors, 'uniform' spreads evenly.

lower_deck_uld.description: Loading format for lower holds, including passenger baggage.

main_deck_door_clear_height_m.description: Clear height of the main-deck cargo door [m]: a freighter's pallets are built up to the fuselage section, but no higher than this opening passes. Unset builds them up to the section.

main_deck_uld.description: Unit load device code for the main deck: the pallets and boxes a freighter's main deck takes, which are far larger than anything that fits a lower hold.

main_door_x_m.description: Longitudinal position of the main-deck cargo door. 0 places it at mid-cabin, which is what the door-proximity strategy measures distance from.

stowage_density_kg_m3.description: Stowage density of freight and baggage [kg/m^3]: a container carries at most its volume times this.

target_cg_pct_mac.description: Centre of gravity the load is trimmed toward [% MAC].

use_main_deck.description: Carry freight on the main deck, as a dedicated freighter does, rather than only in the lower holds. A passenger aircraft has no main-deck cargo.

abreast.description: Seats per row in this class; 0 fits as many as the cabin width allows beside the regulatory aisle (max 6 single-aisle, 12 twin-aisle, FAR/CS 25.817).

pitch_m.description: Row-to-row seat spacing in this class [m]. 0.7112 m (28 in) is the tightest economy pitch in service; business flat-bed suites need 1.5 m or more.

share_pct.description: Target percentage of passengers in this class [%]. The preset supplies the seat geometry; the layout fits the mix into the usable, regulation-compliant cabin.

width_m.description: Lateral footprint of one seat including armrest [m]. 0.4064 m (16 in) is the narrowest economy seat; suites reach about 0.95 m.

checked_bag_mass_kg.description: Checked-bag mass carried in the hold per seated passenger [kg]. Part of the combined mass per passenger: changing it moves mass between cabin and hold, not the total.

aileron_chord_fraction.description: Aileron chord as a fraction of local wing chord.

aileron_span_end_frac.description: Outboard end of the aileron run, as a fraction of wing semi-span.

aileron_span_start_frac.description: Inboard end of the aileron run, as a fraction of wing semi-span.

elevator_chord_fraction.description: Elevator chord as a fraction of local horizontal-stabilizer chord.

elevator_span_end_frac.description: Outboard end of the elevator run, as a fraction of h-stab semi-span.

elevator_span_start_frac.description: Inboard end of the elevator run, as a fraction of h-stab semi-span.

flap_chord_fraction.description: Trailing-edge flap chord as a fraction of local wing chord.

flap_span_end_frac.description: Outboard end of the flap run, as a fraction of wing semi-span.

flap_span_start_frac.description: Inboard end of the flap run (just outside the fuselage), as a fraction of wing semi-span.

inboard_aileron_chord_fraction.description: Chord of the inboard (high-speed) aileron or flaperon as a fraction of local wing chord. Zero means the aircraft has none.

inboard_aileron_span_end_frac.description: Outboard end of the inboard aileron run, as a fraction of wing semi-span.

inboard_aileron_span_start_frac.description: Inboard end of the inboard aileron run, as a fraction of wing semi-span.

rudder_chord_fraction.description: Rudder chord as a fraction of local vertical-stabilizer chord.

rudder_max_deflection_deg.description: Largest rudder deflection each way [deg]. With rudder chord and span it sets the authority for the one-engine-inoperative yaw balance.

rudder_span_end_frac.description: Tip-ward end of the rudder run, as a fraction of v-stab span.

rudder_span_start_frac.description: Root-ward end of the rudder run, as a fraction of v-stab span.

slat_chord_fraction.description: Leading-edge slat chord as a fraction of local wing chord.

slat_span_end_frac.description: Outboard end of the slat run, as a fraction of wing semi-span from the root.

slat_span_start_frac.description: Inboard end of the slat run, as a fraction of wing semi-span from the root.

spoiler_chord_fraction.description: Spoiler/speedbrake chord as a fraction of local wing chord (ahead of the flaps).

spoiler_span_end_frac.description: Outboard end of the spoiler run (typically spanning the flap run), as a fraction of wing semi-span.

spoiler_span_start_frac.description: Inboard end of the spoiler run, as a fraction of wing semi-span.

avl.description: Run Athena Vortex Lattice's independent take-off comparison and keep its SI deck. The Aerodynamic results selector must include AVL.

flowunsteady.description: Run the FLOWUnsteady adapter on the optimized aircraft and keep its request, result and solver logs. Set ALAS_FLOWUNSTEADY_EXE to a compatible executable first.

openvsp.description: Write the optimized aircraft as an inspectable OpenVSP script and, if OpenVSP is configured, its .vsp3 project and CAD preview.

vspaero.description: Run OpenVSP's VSPAERO vortex-lattice comparison on the exported geometry.

exclude_buried_main_wing_area.description: Subtract the tapered centre section inside the local fuselage width at the root quarter chord from the parasite wetted area (NASA NDARC exposed-area convention).

interference_factor_fuselage.description: How much neighbouring components (wing, tail) disturb the fuselage's flow, multiplying its parasite drag.

interference_factor_nacelle.description: How much the engine nacelle and pylon disturb the local flow. Typical value 1.3 for podded under-wing installations (Raymer).

interference_factor_wing.description: How much the wing-fuselage junction disturbs the local flow, multiplying the wing's parasite drag. 1.0 = no interference.

lift_dependent_viscous_fraction.description: Adds CD_v = fraction * CD0 * CL^2 to the clean drag polar: lift-dependent profile drag an inviscid induced drag cannot see.

max_thickness_chordwise_loc.description: Chordwise location of maximum airfoil thickness (as a fraction of chord), used in the wing form factor.

viscous_margin.description: Multiplier on the summed component parasite drag for leakage and protuberances a build-up cannot see (dimensionless).

wave_drag_coefficient.description: Leading constant of the Lock/Korn wave-drag rise: CD_wave = coefficient * max(M - M_critical, 0)^4 (dimensionless). Must be positive.

wave_drag_onset_mach.description: Below this Mach number, transonic wave drag is assumed zero.

additional_fuel_kg.description: Fuel for specific cases the general reserves do not cover, such as engine failure or depressurisation on an extended-diversion route [kg]. Zero unless studied.

alternate_distance_nmi.description: Still-air distance from destination to alternate aerodrome after a missed approach [nmi].

contingency_minimum_hold_min.description: Minimum contingency fuel as holding time over the destination at the estimated landing mass [min]. EASA basic requires at least 5 min; zero removes the floor.

contingency_trip_fraction.description: Contingency fuel as a fraction of planned trip fuel. EASA basic 0.05 (0.03 with an en-route alternate); FAA flag rule 0.10 of flight time; domestic none.

domestic_cruise_reserve_min.description: Flight time at normal cruise consumption carried after the alternate, 14 CFR 121.639 [min]. 45 min is the rule; read only for the FAA domestic scheme.

expansion_space_fraction.description: Share of every tank's geometric volume that cannot be filled, held for thermal expansion of the fuel. CS 25.969 and 14 CFR 25.969 require at least two percent of the tank capacity.

extra_fuel_kg.description: Fuel added above the planned requirement, either for anticipated delays (extra) or at the commander's discretion. It is carried and burned last, so it only raises the takeoff mass.

final_reserve_hold_min.description: Holding time over the alternate (or destination) at the estimated landing mass [min]. 30 min is the EASA basic and FAA flag value; FAA domestic uses 45 min.

flag_flight_time_fraction.description: Fraction of total flight time to the destination carried as reserve fuel, 14 CFR 121.645(b). 0.10 is the rule; read only for the FAA flag/supplemental scheme.

fly_policy_load_case.description: On: fly the route at the takeoff mass the fuel policy requires, within mass and tank limits, and check the reserves.

holding_altitude_ft.description: Height above aerodrome elevation at which contingency and final-reserve holding fuel is evaluated. Every scheme here states 1,500 ft in standard conditions.

scheme.description: Operating rule that splits fuel on board into taxi, trip, contingency, alternate, final reserve, additional, extra and discretionary fuel.

taxi_time_min.description: Ground time at idle fuel flow before takeoff [min]; the ramp mass carries it above the takeoff mass. 10-15 min is representative of a large hub.

unusable_fuel_fraction.description: Fraction of usable tank capacity left undeliverable in the most adverse feed condition. CS 25.959 requires test; 0.005-0.01 is typical. Counts as operating empty mass.

burn_priority.description: Order in which the auxiliary tank is consumed: lower numbers are used first. Fuselage fuel is transferred into the wing tanks early in cruise.

enabled.description: Whether a fuselage auxiliary tank is installed, such as the Learjet 60 fuselage tank or an extra tank in the cargo hold. Its capacity is a declared volume.

usable_volume_l.description: Usable volume of the auxiliary tank. It is a declared quantity rather than a geometric estimate.

x_position_fraction.description: Centroid of the auxiliary tank as a fraction of fuselage length from the nose [0-1].

calibrate_to_published_capacity.description: For a preset with a published total usable volume, scale every geometric tank estimate by one common factor to reproduce it.

burn_priority.description: Order in which the centre tank is used; lower numbers first.

enabled.description: Whether the wing carry-through box under the cabin floor is a fuel tank. Most transports have one; some short-range variants leave it dry.

published_usable_volume_l.description: Manufacturer's published usable volume for the centre tank [L]. When set it is the authoritative capacity; the geometry only supplies the centroid.

usable_fraction.description: Fraction of the carry-through spar-box volume between the body sides that is usable tank volume (dimensionless). Lower than a wing tank: keel, gear and systems cross it.

burn_priority.description: Order in which the tank is used in normal operation; lower numbers first.

enabled.description: Whether this wing tank exists on the aircraft. A tank that is not installed contributes no capacity, no centroid and no unusable fuel.
Whether part of this wing cell is an engine feed tank, kept as a separate tank for the fill and burn sequence.

published_usable_volume_l.description: Manufacturer's published usable volume for this feed tank, both sides together [L].

span_end_fraction.description: Outboard boundary of the feed tank as a fraction of the semi-span. The feed tank must lie inside its host cell and share one of its ends.

span_start_fraction.description: Inboard boundary of the feed tank as a fraction of the semi-span. The feed tank must lie inside its host cell and share one of its ends.

span_end_fraction.description: Outboard boundary of the tank as a fraction of the semi-span. Transport wing tanks end short of the tip, leaving the outer bays dry for the ailerons and the surge tank.

span_start_fraction.description: Inboard boundary of the tank as a fraction of the semi-span from the centreline [0-1].
