burn_priority.description: Order in which the trim tank is consumed: lower numbers are used first. In service it is transferred forward late in cruise so the aircraft lands with it empty.

enabled.description: Whether the horizontal stabiliser box is a fuel tank. Long-range Airbus types use one to hold the cruise centre of gravity aft and cut trim drag; most twins do not have one.

published_usable_volume_l.description: Usable volume published by the manufacturer for the trim tank. When set it is the authoritative capacity and the geometric estimate only supplies the centroid.

span_end_fraction.description: Outboard boundary of the trim tank as a fraction of the stabiliser semi-span.

span_start_fraction.description: Inboard boundary of the trim tank as a fraction of the stabiliser semi-span from the aircraft centreline.

transfer_rate_kg_s.description: Sustained pump rate moving trim fuel between the trim tank and the feed tanks [kg/s], from manufacturer data.

usable_fraction.description: Share of the geometric stabiliser spar-box volume between the two stations that is usable tank volume.

hstab_edge_stations.description: Optional stations that offset the built tailplane edges from their straight lines: a rounded tip corner. The straight-edged trapezoid stays the reference planform.

hstab_offset_from_tail_m.description: How far forward of the fuselage tail tip the horizontal-stabiliser root leading edge sits.

x-alas.label: H-stab offset forward of tail tip

hstab_root_chord_m.description: Chord of the horizontal-stabiliser root section, before the design vector's tail scale is applied.

hstab_root_le_x_m.description: Absolute position of the horizontal-stabiliser leading edge at its root, measured aft from the nose tip [m].

x-alas.label: H-stab root leading edge x (from nose)

hstab_root_station_y_m.description: Distance from the centreline of the station where tailplane root chord, incidence, offset and leading edge x are drawn [m] (the fuselage side).

hstab_root_twist_deg.description: Incidence of the horizontal stabiliser root, usually slightly negative to trim the wing's nose-down pitching moment.

hstab_tip_chord_m.description: Chord of the horizontal-stabiliser tip section, before the design vector's tail scale is applied. Shorter than the root chord gives a tapered surface.

hstab_tip_le_m.description: Position of the horizontal-stabiliser tip leading edge relative to its root, as (x, y, z).

x-alas.label: H-stab tip leading edge (x, y, z)

hstab_tip_twist_deg.description: Incidence of the horizontal stabiliser tip. Equal to the root incidence gives an untwisted surface, which is what a trimming tail normally has.

hstab_z_m.description: Vertical placement of the horizontal stabiliser relative to the fuselage centerline.

n_subdivisions.description: Spanwise vortex-lattice panels across each tail surface, as an absolute count rather than per section, so a later cranked fin gets the same density.

tail_airfoil.description: Reference airfoil shared by both the horizontal and vertical stabilisers (usually symmetric, e.g. NACA 00xx).

ventral_fin_stations.description: Optional drawn stations of a ventral fin pair under the tail. Part of the geometry, wetted area, drag build-up and paint; outside the vortex lattice.

vstab_airfoil.description: Optional section of the vertical stabiliser; empty builds it from the tail airfoil section. The dorsal fillet stays a flat plate.

vstab_dorsal_height_m.description: Height above the fin root line at which the dorsal fillet meets the fin leading edge. Needs the dorsal length too; leave both unset for a fin without a dorsal.

vstab_dorsal_in_aero.description: Add the dorsal fillet to the vortex lattice as a lifting surface. Off, the fillet is part of the geometry, wetted area and drag build-up but carries no lift: test data show no effect on the fin lift curve up to 15 deg of sideslip.

vstab_dorsal_length_m.description: How far ahead of the fin root leading edge the dorsal fillet leaves the top of the body [m].

x-alas.label: Dorsal fin length ahead of fin

vstab_dorsal_seat_rise_m.description: Height above the top of the body at which the dorsal fillet's side line starts, for a line that comes out from behind a nacelle [m]. Unset starts on the body.

vstab_dorsal_shoulder.description: How full the dorsal fillet's side line is, between 0 and 1: near 0 a straight line from the body to the fin, 0.3 when unset.

vstab_edge_stations.description: Optional stations that offset the built fin edges from their straight lines: a rounded tip corner, a cap sloping down aft. The straight-edged trapezoid stays the reference planform.

vstab_offset_from_tail_m.description: How far forward of the fuselage tail tip the vertical-stabiliser root leading edge sits.

x-alas.label: V-stab offset forward of tail tip

vstab_reference_end_fraction.description: Optional end of the fin's reference planform, as a fraction of its straight lines with 1 at the tip. Unset, a T-tail's reference fin ends at the tailplane seat.

vstab_root_chord_m.description: Chord of the vertical-stabiliser root section, before the design vector's tail scale is applied.

vstab_root_le_x_m.description: Absolute position of the fin leading edge on its root line, measured aft from the nose tip [m].

x-alas.label: V-stab root leading edge x (from nose)

vstab_thickness_stations.description: Optional stations scaling the fin section thickness from root to tip, for a fin that thins toward its tip. Chords and areas do not change.

vstab_tip_chord_m.description: Chord of the vertical-stabiliser tip section, before the design vector's tail scale is applied.

vstab_tip_le_m.description: Position of the vertical-stabiliser tip leading edge relative to its root, as (x, y, z).

x-alas.label: V-stab tip leading edge (x, y, z)

vstab_z_m.description: Vertical placement of the fin root line relative to the fuselage centreline [m], usually the fuselage top line at the fin.

bypass_ratio.description: Ratio of bypass (fan duct) to core mass flow. Feeds the mission turbofan network and the Propulsion Analysis on-design cycle.

cruise_tsfc_kg_kgf_hr.description: Reference cruise thrust-specific fuel consumption for the Breguet payload-range diagram. It is the in-service figure, not the Propulsion Analysis on-design-cycle TSFC.

engine_name.description: Name from the built-in engine database (see the Engine selector on the Aircraft page): drives thrust, mass, and the default nacelle profile.

fan_diameter_m.description: Fan face diameter: informational/reference only (does not currently size the nacelle profile, which comes from radius_scale_m/nacelle_profile above).

fan_pressure_ratio.description: Pressure ratio across the fan (bypass stream), separate from the core OPR above.

inlet_x_offset_m.description: How far forward of the (swept) wing leading edge the nacelle inlet face sits.

x-alas.label: Inlet offset ahead of wing LE

nacelle_profile.description: Pairs of x-station [m] and radius fraction [0-1 of radius_scale_m] tracing the nacelle silhouette from inlet (x=0) to exit.

overall_pressure_ratio.description: Total pressure ratio through the core compressors (LPC x HPC, not including the fan).

part_power_fuel_flow_ratios.description: Fuel flow divided by take-off fuel flow at 7, 30, 85 and 100 % of rated net thrust.

part_power_source.description: ICAO Engine Emissions Databank UID/variant, or a clearly identified family proxy when an exact entry is unavailable.

radius_scale_m.description: Physical radius the nacelle_profile's fraction-of-1.0 points are scaled by.

spanwise_positions_m.description: Y-coordinate of each engine's mount position (negative = left/port side); one entry per engine.

turbine_inlet_temp_k.description: Combustor-exit stagnation temperature: the primary driver of specific thrust and thermal efficiency in the on-design cycle.

z_m.description: Vertical placement of the engine centerline relative to the wing reference plane (negative = below the wing).

aft_belly_exponent.description: Exponent of the belly line rising to the tail end (dimensionless): 1 is a straight ramp, larger starts gently and steepens. Unset takes 1. Valid 1-3.

aft_crown_exponent.description: Exponent of the crown drop (dimensionless): 1 is straight, larger keeps the crown level longer. Unset takes 1.5. Valid 1-3.

aft_crown_length_m.description: Length of the crown (upper line) drop ahead of the tail end [m]. Unset takes the tailcone length.

aft_plan_exponent.description: Exponent of the plan-view half-width taper (dimensionless): 1 is a straight cone, larger keeps the width longer. Unset takes 1.5. Valid 1-3.

aft_plan_length_m.description: Length of the plan-view (width) taper ahead of the tail end. Unset takes the tailcone length. Real aft bodies narrow in plan well ahead of the crown line dropping.

belly_upsweep_length_m.description: Distance ahead of the tail tip where the lower fuselage line starts rising straight to the tail tip [m]; sets the tail-strike angle. Unset keeps the tailcone law.

cabin_section.description: Drawn cabin cross-section: floor and hold polygon.

cabin_start_x_m.description: X-station where the fuselage first reaches full diameter, i.e. the end of the nose taper.

cabin_z_m.description: Vertical offset of the cylindrical cabin section relative to the fuselage centerline.

custom_sections.description: Additional validated fuselage sections supplied by the user; edited by the custom-geometry editor rather than the generated scalar form.

diameter_m.description: Maximum fuselage cross-sectional diameter: the main driver of cabin width and wetted area. Best judged on the 3-view preview's front/isometric panels, not the top view.

gear_sponson_depth_m.description: Depth of the main-gear sponsons below the keel of the body. Not drawn on the built body.

gear_sponson_half_width_m.description: Largest half width over the main-gear sponsons, from the centreline. Not drawn on the built body.

gear_sponson_length_m.description: Length of the main-gear sponsons of a high wing. Not drawn on the built body: it only adds their wetted area to the parasite drag. Unset for a body without sponsons.

generated_sections.description: Per-station overrides of the generated fuselage loft.

height_m.description: Vertical cross-section dimension. Leave blank/none for a circular fuselage where height equals diameter.

hold_interior_end_x_m.description: Distance from the nose tip up to which the loadable interior (hold, ramp floor) keeps the full cabin keel [m].

hump_crown_end_x_m.description: Distance from the nose tip at which the aft fairing of the hump starts to descend.

hump_crown_start_x_m.description: Distance from the nose tip at which the hump reaches its full height; the fore fairing runs from the hump start to here.

hump_end_x_m.description: Distance from the nose tip at which the aft fairing of the hump is back on the main crown.

hump_fairing_exponent.description: Exponent of both hump fairings (dimensionless): 2 is tangent to the hump crown, larger gives a fuller hump, 1 a straight ramp. Unset takes 2. Valid 1-4.

hump_height_m.description: Rise of the crown above the main crown over the full-height part of an upper-deck hump (Boeing 747 type) [m].

hump_start_x_m.description: Distance from the nose tip at which the crown starts to rise into the hump (the windshield line of a 747).

loft.description: Embedded lofted outer surface (id under data/lofts); unset keeps the parametric laws.

n_subdivisions.description: Number of longitudinal stations used to loft the fuselage body. Higher = smoother surface, slower to draw.

nose_crown_end_fraction.description: Fraction of the nose length at which the upper line reaches the cabin crown with zero slope (dimensionless).

nose_keel_exponent.description: Exponent of the lower nose line from tip to cabin keel (dimensionless): larger gives a deeper chin radome.

nose_length_m.description: Distance from the nose tip at which the lofted body reaches full section [m], read from the drawing. Unset takes the cabin start X.

nose_plan_exponent.description: Exponent of the plan-view half-width from the tip to the cabin width: smaller values give a pointier plan view. Unset takes a narrow-body class estimate (about 2). Valid 1 to 2.6.

nose_radome_length_fraction.description: Fraction of the nose length occupied by the radome, from the tip to the windshield base. Unset takes a narrow-body class estimate (about 0.3). Valid 0.1 to 0.45.

nose_section_exponent.description: Peak superellipse exponent of the nose cross-sections (dimensionless), reached mid-nose; larger gives flatter cockpit sides. Unset about 2.4. Valid 2-3.5.

nose_windshield_angle_deg.description: Side-view angle of the straight windshield to the waterline [deg].

nose_z_m.description: Vertical offset of the nose tip relative to the fuselage centerline.

tail_end_height_m.description: Full height of the finite closing section at the tail end, centred on the tail vertical offset. Unset closes the body to a point, the tailcone law.

tail_end_width_m.description: Full width of the finite closing section at the tail end (APU exhaust or tail-cone cap) instead of a point [m]. Unset closes to a point.

tail_end_z_m.description: Vertical offset of the closing section centre at the tail end relative to the fuselage centreline [m].

tail_z_m.description: Vertical offset of the upswept tail tip (positive = tail rises above centerline, typical for ground clearance/rotation).

tailcone_length_m.description: Length of the aft taper, from the end of the cylindrical cabin section to the tail tip.

upper_deck_end_x_m.description: Distance from the nose tip of the aft end of the usable upper-deck floor. Unset takes the hump crown end.

upper_deck_floor_height_m.description: Height of the upper-deck floor above the main-deck floor under the hump [m].

upper_deck_start_x_m.description: Distance from the nose tip of the forward end of the usable upper-deck floor (aft of the flight deck). Unset takes the hump crown start.

fuselage_wetted_factor.description: Correction factor on pi*diameter*length for a non-cylindrical (tapered nose/tail) fuselage body.

airfoil_class.description: Declared section technology of the main wing (conventional or supercritical), fixing the Korn factor: 0.87 conventional, 0.95 supercritical (Mason).

break_span_fraction.description: Spanwise position of the trailing-edge break, as a fraction of the semispan (0 = root, 1 = tip).

break_twist_deg.description: Geometric twist of the mid-span break section.

break_z_m.description: Vertical placement of the mid-span 'break' section leading edge, where the taper/dihedral rate changes.

custom_sections.description: Additional validated wing sections supplied by the user; edited by the custom-geometry editor rather than the generated scalar form.

dihedral_stations.description: Optional interior stations that bend the root-break-tip height polyline: dihedral that varies along the span (see WingDihedralStation).

drag_divergence_law.description: Relation giving the wing drag-divergence Mach number: auto follows the section class, korn is Korn's relation, torenbeek1048 is Torenbeek's Eq. 10.48.

edge_stations.description: Optional stations that offset the drawn leading and trailing edges from their straight lines: an inboard trailing-edge break, a leading-edge fillet, a curved raked tip.

flight_root_rise_m.description: Optional rise of the wing-root height from the static ground shape to the 1 g flight shape [m]; the flight height polyline starts at the raised root.

flight_tip_rise_semispan_fraction.description: Rise of the wing tip from the static ground shape to the 1 g flight shape, as a fraction of semispan.

inboard_le_sweep_deg.description: Optional leading-edge sweep of the inboard panel (centreline to kink) [deg]. Unset runs the design-vector sweep straight to the tip.

kink_span_fraction.description: Optional Yehudi-kink station as a semispan fraction. When unset, the legacy wing break span location remains active.

korn_technology_factor_override.description: Optional Korn technology factor overriding the section class value (0.87 conventional, 0.95 supercritical); valid 0.80-1.00. Needs a documented section-technology source.

n_subdivisions.description: Spanwise vortex-lattice panels across the whole wing semispan, as an absolute count. Every planform station stays a panel edge.

nacelles_hold_ground_height.description: When set, nacelles hang from the static ground-shape wing in the flight shape too, as manufacturer front views draw them, instead of rising with the wing.

outboard_le_sweep_deg.description: Legacy reference-replay override. Product transport wings use the design-vector sweep across both panels so this value cannot create an unintended leading-edge crank.

outboard_sweep_decrement_deg.description: How many degrees less swept the outboard panel is than the inboard panel (a common yehudi/crank shape).

reference_wing.description: Reference-wing convention: Drawn quotes S_ref, b_ref and MAC on the drawn planform; Trapezoid on the manufacturer reference trapezoid.

root_airfoil.description: Reference airfoil at the wing root, morphed by the design vector's thickness/camber scale factors.

root_datum_x_m.description: Fuselage-station X of the wing-root leading-edge datum: how far aft of the nose the wing sits.

root_twist_deg.description: Geometric twist (incidence) of the root section, positive = leading-edge-up (washin).

root_z_m.description: Vertical (Z) placement of the wing-root leading edge relative to the fuselage centerline.

section_stations.description: Optional interior stations naming the wing section at each; the loft blends between them, with the root and tip airfoils at the ends (see WingSectionStation).

side_of_body_chord_ratio.description: Optional side-of-body chord divided by root chord. A value near one retains wing-box and high-lift depth inboard.

side_of_body_span_fraction.description: Optional fuselage side-of-body station as a semispan fraction. Leave unset to retain the legacy centerline-root planform.

te_break_2_chord_offset_m.description: Optional extra chord at the second outboard trailing-edge break [m], added to the straight kink-to-tip chord (positive moves the trailing edge aft).

te_break_2_span_fraction.description: Optional span fraction of a second outboard trailing-edge break, outboard of the first and inboard of the tip rake (with its chord offset).

te_break_chord_offset_m.description: Optional extra chord at the outboard trailing-edge break [m], added to the straight kink-to-tip chord (positive moves the trailing edge aft).

te_break_span_fraction.description: Optional span fraction of an outboard trailing-edge break between kink and tip (with the break chord offset).

thickness_stations.description: Optional stations scaling the section thickness along the span so a thick root falls to a thin outer wing (see WingThicknessStation).

tip_airfoil.description: Reference airfoil at the wing tip.

tip_rake_start_span_fraction.description: Optional span fraction where a swept-back tip begins (used with the rake tip chord).

tip_rake_tip_chord_m.description: Optional chord at the extreme tip of a swept-back tip [m].

tip_z_m.description: Vertical placement of the wing-tip leading edge. Tip above root gives positive dihedral.

wing_profile_interpolation.description: Interpolation of the spanwise dihedral, twist and thickness profiles: piecewise linear, or a C2 cubic spline through every station.

wingtip_device.description: Optional wingtip device (winglet, sharklet or tip fence) added as an extra lifting surface at the wing tip.

wing_wetted_area_factor.description: Ratio of wetted (exposed, both sides) surface area to planform area for a thin wing. Used by the drag buildup.

cl_ground_attitude_frac_of_cl_max_to.description: Wing-body lift coefficient at the ground attitude at V_R, as a fraction of CLmax_TO [0-1]: before rotation the angle of attack is low and gear-limited.

elevator_up_travel_deg.description: Trailing-edge-up elevator travel at takeoff rotation [deg, positive], used by the forward-CG nose-wheel-liftoff balance.

fuselage_ground_clearance_m.description: Static strut length (belly clearance) from the fuselage lower surface to the ground line [m].

min_tip_back_deg.description: Optional extra floor on the longitudinal tip-back angle at the most-aft main axle and most-aft CG [deg]. It must always clear the tail-scrape angle.

mlg_body_gear_mtow_kg.description: Auto-sizing adds two centreline body-gear legs (4 main legs total) above this MTOW.

x-alas.label: MTOW threshold for body (centreline) main gear

mlg_strut_bogie_wheels.description: Optional bogie counts per strut in layout order: left wing, right wing, then centreline/body gear. Use even counts (2, 4 or 6), one per main-gear strut.

mlg_tire.description: Certified main-gear tire designation as printed in the aircraft documents (for example H49x19.0-22/32PR). 'auto' sizes from the tire class.

n_mlg_struts.description: Number of main-gear legs, left and right combined. 0 is auto: 2 below mlg_body_gear_mtow_kg, 4 (adds centreline body gear, A380/747 class) above it.

n_nlg_wheels.description: Wheels on the nose gear strut. 0 = auto: 1 for light aircraft, 2 (the near-universal choice for CS-25/FAR-25 transports) once MTOW exceeds nlg_dual_wheel_mtow_kg.

nlg_dual_wheel_mtow_kg.description: Auto-sizing switches from a single to a dual (twin) nose wheel above this MTOW: below it, transport-category aircraft still commonly fly single nose wheels.

x-alas.label: MTOW threshold for dual nose wheels

nlg_dynamic_braking_decel_g.description: Deceleration for the nose-gear dynamic braking reaction, in g. 14 CFR 25.733(b)(2): 1.0 g down with 0.31 g forward; load must not exceed 1.5x the static rating.

nlg_tire.description: Certified nose-gear tire designation as printed in the aircraft documents (for example 49x17/32PR). 'auto' sizes from the tire class.

pitch_radius_of_gyration_frac_mac.description: Optional override of the pitch radius of gyration r_y, as a fraction of MAC, in the nose-wheel-liftoff balance.

x-alas.label: Pitch radius of gyration (fraction of MAC)

reference_body_wheelbase_m.description: Published nose-gear to body-main-gear wheelbase kept for a distinct source comparison [m].

reference_track_m.description: Published main-gear track used as a source baseline when its definition matches the layout [m].

reference_wheelbase_m.description: Published nose-gear to primary main-gear wheelbase, kept for comparison [m].

required_rotation_angle_deg.description: Pitch attitude reachable at rotation (VR) without tail scrape [deg]: the tail-scrape angle must be at least this. 10 deg is typical of transports, an assumption.

rotation_pitch_acceleration_deg_s2.description: Optional override of the required pitch angular acceleration at rotation in the forward-CG nose-wheel-liftoff balance [deg/s^2].

rotation_rolling_friction_coefficient.description: Tire rolling-friction coefficient on a dry paved runway during the takeoff roll (dimensionless). 0.02 is the usual conceptual value; an estimate.

stabilizer_nose_up_travel_deg.description: Largest nose-up setting of the trimmable stabiliser from the flight-control data (FCOM or AMM) [deg].

strut_material.description: Landing-gear strut material, shown on the planform diagram and report. 'auto' selects by MTOW class (300M-class steel for larger transports).

takeoff_stabilizer_nose_up_deg.description: Nose-up takeoff setting of a trimmable stabiliser against the fuselage reference line [deg].

tire_class.description: Which reference tire class to size with: 'auto' picks the smallest class whose rated load, with at most 6 wheels per strut, covers the static gear loads.

tire_dynamic_rating_factor.description: A tire's dynamic (braking) rated load as a multiple of its static rating (dimensionless). 14 CFR 25.733(b) caps nose-gear braking load at 1.5x.

tire_safety_factor.description: Margin applied to the static reaction load when selecting tire count (dimensionless), so rated tire load is never fully used by static load alone.

track_diameter_factor.description: Main-gear lateral track as a multiple of fuselage diameter (dimensionless).

trimmable_stabilizer.description: Whether the horizontal stabiliser is trimmable (a THS, as on jet transports), set before takeoff for the takeoff CG.

turnover_angle_limit_deg.description: Maximum lateral tip-over angle from vertical at the forward CG limit [deg] (Raymer Ch. 11 / Currey). 63 deg is the transport-category limit.

wheels_per_mlg_strut.description: 0 = auto: the smallest of {2, 4, 6} standard bogie sizes whose rated capacity (tire_safety_factor-derated) covers this strut's static reaction load at the aft CG limit.

lda_override_m.description: Design landing distance available for this case [m]. The requirement uses the shorter of this and the arrival aerodrome's value, so it can only tighten it.

cabin_payload_density_kg_m.description: Payload mass per metre of occupied cabin length [kg/m]. Used only to place the payload/systems CG, not the payload mass.

flap_deflection_angle_deg.description: Legacy comparison only: maximum flap deflection angle, fed into the Torenbeek wing-mass formula.

aeroelastic_tailoring.description: FLOPS FAERT: 0 for no aeroelastic tailoring, 1 for the maximum tailoring benefit in the wing bending material.

baseline_engine_mass_kg.description: FLOPS WENGB, declared dry mass of the baseline engine [kg]. Blank uses the FLOPS estimate of baseline thrust over 5.5 (eq. 76).

baseline_engine_thrust_kn.description: FLOPS THRSO: sea-level static rated thrust of the baseline engine the mass is scaled from. Blank uses the installed engine's rated thrust, so the scaling ratio is one.

baseline_inlet_mass_kg.description: FLOPS WINLB, inlet mass of the baseline engine [kg], declared separately (eq. 77). Blank means it is already in the engine mass.

baseline_nozzle_mass_kg.description: FLOPS WNOZB, nozzle mass of the baseline engine [kg], declared separately (eq. 78). Blank means it is already in the engine mass. Needs an explicit baseline engine mass.

composite_utilization.description: FLOPS FCOMP, composite utilization factor for wing structure: 0 for no composites to 1 for maximum use (NASA/TM-2017-219627). Not a material percentage.

design_gross_mass_kg.description: FLOPS DG, design gross mass [kg] for the wing, tail, fuselage, control and pod-relief equations. Blank uses the takeoff mass being evaluated.

design_landing_mass_kg.description: FLOPS WLDG for the landing-gear equations. Blank uses the maximum landing mass fraction of the mass model applied to the design gross mass.

design_zero_fuel_mass_kg.description: Maximum zero-fuel mass [kg] for the fuselage bending term of the regional turboprop pressurized fuselage method. Blank uses the structural design gross mass.

empty_mass_margin_fraction.description: FLOPS WMARG expressed as a fraction of the computed structural, propulsion and systems mass, added to the empty mass (equation 139). Zero adds no margin.

engine_mass_scaling_exponent.description: FLOPS EEXP, exponent on the thrust ratio when the baseline engine is scaled (eq. 75). Values below 0.3 give a linear mass-per-thrust slope. Default 1.15.

inlet_mass_scaling_exponent.description: FLOPS EINL: exponent on the thrust ratio when the baseline inlet is scaled (equation 77). The FLOPS default is 1.

main_gear_oleo_length_m.description: FLOPS XMLG, length of the extended main-gear oleo [m].

maximum_operating_altitude_m.description: Certified maximum operating altitude [m]. Sizes the pressurized shell of the regional turboprop class for the differential against an 8,000 ft cabin.

military_cargo_floor.description: FLOPS CARGF: 0 for a passenger transport fuselage, 1 for a military cargo transport floor (38 percent fuselage structure penalty).

misc_propulsion_mass_kg.description: FLOPS WPMISC: declared propulsion-system mass added to the engine controls and starters (equation 91).

nose_gear_oleo_length_m.description: FLOPS XNLG: length of the extended nose landing-gear oleo. Blank uses 70 percent of the main-gear length (equation 67).

nozzle_mass_scaling_exponent.description: FLOPS ENOZ: exponent on the thrust ratio when the baseline nozzle is scaled (equation 78). The FLOPS default is 1.

nozzle_scope.description: Whether the baseline engine mass includes the nozzle, declares it as a separate eq. 78 term, or leaves it outside or unknown (no nozzle mass is invented).

paint_area_density_kg_m2.description: FLOPS WPAINT, paint mass per wetted area [kg/m^2] on wings, tails, fuselage and nacelles. Validated NASA decks use 0.1807 kg/m^2 (0.037 lbm/ft^2); zero means unpainted.

pylon_mass_method.description: Published FLOPS has no pylon term.

starter_scope.description: Whether the declared engine dry mass already includes the starter system.

strut_bracing.description: FLOPS FSTRT: 0 for a cantilever wing, 1 for full benefit from strut bracing.

thrust_reverser_engine_count.description: The number of engines fitted with a thrust reverser, when only some reverse. Blank charges equation 86 on every nacelle (FLOPS TNAC).

thrust_reversers_installed.description: Include the FLOPS thrust-reverser mass of 3.4 percent of rated thrust per nacelle (equation 86). Disable for an installation without reversers.

wing_bending_method.description: FLOPS wing bending material factor: the simplified trapezoidal fit (eq. 10) or the detailed load-path integration (eqs. 18-32) over the built planform.

wing_load_fraction.description: FLOPS PCTL: fraction of the aircraft load carried by the defined wing. 1 for a conventional single wing.

apu_installed.description: Whether the aircraft carries an APU. NASA FLOPS equation 101 is evaluated when true; an architecture with hotel power from an installed engine declares false.

business_class_passenger_count.description: Follows the cabin layout automatically: the installed business-class seat count comes from the Cabin class configuration; edit the cabin to change it.

cabin_equipment_method.description: FLOPS eq. 110 and operating-item eqs. 119-126 as published, or the LTH civil-transport relations.

cargo_loading.description: Whether the holds are loose-loaded (bulk), containerized (ULD) or mixed. FLOPS eqs. 125-126 charge 175 lb of container per 950 lb of containerized mass.

containerized_baggage_fraction.description: Read only for mixed hold loading: the fraction of checked baggage in unit load devices rather than loose bulk (0-1), normally the containerized share of hold volume.

containerized_cargo_kg.description: Cargo loaded into standardized containers for FLOPS WCON. Enter zero explicitly when no containerized cargo is carried.

design_range_nmi.description: FLOPS DESRNG from a revision-locked aircraft design source. A marketing maximum or the selected airport route is not silently substituted.

first_class_passenger_count.description: Follows the cabin layout automatically: the installed first-class seat count comes from the Cabin class configuration; edit the cabin to change it.

flight_attendant_count.description: Installed cabin flight attendants. Follows the cabin layout: never fewer than one per 50 passenger seats (EASA ORO.CC.100, 14 CFR 121.391); a larger value you enter is kept.

flight_crew_count.description: Installed flight-deck crew used by the FLOPS instruments, electrical, avionics, furnishings, and operating-item equations.

fuel_tank_count.description: FLOPS NTANK: physical tanks represented by the declared fuel-system topology.

fuselage_mounted_engine_count.description: FLOPS FNEF, including empennage-mounted installations. Wing and fuselage counts must sum to the built engine count.

galley_crew_count.description: Installed galley-service crew. Enter zero explicitly when the aircraft carries none.

haul_class.description: Read only by the LTH cabin-equipment method, which has separate operating-item relations for short/medium-haul and long-haul aircraft.

hydraulic_pressure_pa.description: Declared hydraulic working pressure. The FLOPS 3,000 psi reference appears inside its equation; it is not a missing-input default.

manual_cabin_inputs.description: Off (Auto): the class counts and the cabin crew follow the cabin layout and one attendant per 50 seats. On: the values below are used as entered.

maximum_fuel_capacity_kg.description: FLOPS FMXTOT: source-backed maximum usable fuel capacity across wing, fuselage, and auxiliary tanks.

maximum_mach.description: FLOPS VMAX: the maximum operating or design Mach number. Cruise Mach is not substituted because the two are different certification quantities.

provenance.description: Mission, cabin, and installed-architecture provenance required before FLOPS can report a verified component buildup.

tourist_class_passenger_count.description: Follows the cabin layout automatically: the installed economy/tourist seat count comes from the Cabin class configuration; edit the cabin to change it.

variable_sweep_penalty.description: FLOPS VARSWP: enter 0 for a declared fixed wing and 1 for full variable sweep. Absence is not treated as fixed geometry.

wing_mounted_engine_count.description: FLOPS FNEW. This is declared because a centerline engine cannot be classified safely from coordinates alone.

baseline_shaft_power_kw.description: Take-off shaft power of the engine the declared dry mass was measured at [kW].

engine_dry_mass_kg.description: Certificated dry mass of one engine [kg]; for the PW100 family it includes the reduction gearbox.

engine_installation_mass_kg.description: Engine controls, starters, mounts, fire protection and installation accessories for all engines together [kg].

engine_mass_scaling_exponent.description: Exponent on the shaft-power ratio when scaling a declared engine dry mass to another rating (dimensionless). 1 gives the linear NASA GASP relation.

engine_oil_mass_kg.description: Engine oil for all installed engines together [kg]. FLOPS eq. 123 uses rated thrust and eq. 162 is unusable as printed, so this is declared.

gearbox_inside_engine_mass.description: The certificated PW100 dry weight already includes the gearbox, so a separate gearbox estimate would be counted twice.

nacelle_area_density_kg_m2.description: NASA GASP UW_NAC (CR-152303 eq. V.1.6): an empirical nacelle component area coefficient, not a material density; a declared model input.

nacelle_reference_area_m2.description: Optional reference wetted area of one nacelle matching the reference component mass [m^2].

nacelle_reference_mass_kg.description: Optional source-backed mass of one nacelle component [kg], used with the reference area below.

propeller_accessory_mass_kg.description: Spinner, blade de-icing and governor mass for one propeller [kg].

propeller_activity_factor.description: Hamilton Standard blade activity factor A.F. per blade (NASA CR-152303 Vol. V equation V.1.28). Zero blocks the propeller mass instead of assuming a value.

propeller_assembly_accessories_included.description: Scope of a declared propeller assembly mass.

propeller_assembly_mass_kg.description: Optional source-backed mass of one propeller item. When present it replaces the generic Hamilton Standard regression; clear it when changing the propeller design.

propeller_blade_count.description: Number of blades on one propeller, the Hamilton Standard B of NASA CR-152303 Vol. V equation V.1.28.

propeller_weight_coefficient.description: Hamilton Standard K_w (dimensionless). Blank uses the published constant (355 double-acting aluminium, 220 single-acting).

pylon_coefficient.description: NASA GASP F_PYL (CR-152303 eq. V.1.7): W_PYLON = F_PYL (W_ENG + W_NAC)^0.736 for multi-engine installations.

fuel_density_kg_m3.description: Jet-A/Jet-A1 density at 15C (~804 kg/m^3). Converts wing tank volume to a fuel-mass capacity for the payload-range diagram and the wing fuel-volume check.

fuel_tank_usable_fraction.description: Fraction of the wing's geometric (Torenbeek) fuel volume that is usable tank capacity, after structure, ribs, systems and unusable fuel [0-1].

furnishings_mass_fraction.description: Legacy comparison only: passenger seats, galleys, lavatories, insulation, crew, paint, and operational empty items as a fraction of MTOW. Typically 10-14% for passenger transports.

geometric_component_stations.description: Place mass groups at built geometry stations (tails at 42 % mean chord, gear, engines at nacelles, fuel in tanks).

landing_gear_mass_fraction.description: Legacy comparison only: landing gear mass as a fraction of MTOW. Raymer Table 15.2: ~4% for commercial jet transports.

mass_architecture.description: The method that owns every mass group.

max_airspeed_for_flaps_ms.description: Legacy comparison only: design airspeed with flaps extended, fed into the Torenbeek wing-mass formula.

mlg_x_fraction_mac.description: Main landing gear longitudinal position, as a fraction of the mean aerodynamic chord aft of the MAC leading edge.

x-alas.label: Main-gear X position
x-alas.unit: fraction of MAC aft of MAC LE

mlw_fraction_mtow.description: Maximum Landing Weight (MLW) as a fraction of MTOW, shown as a reference line on the CG envelope.

x-alas.label: Max landing weight fraction of MTOW

nlg_x_fraction.description: Nose landing gear longitudinal position, as a fraction of total fuselage length from the nose.

pct_load_mlg_max.description: Maximum fraction of total aircraft weight the main gear is rated to carry: sets the 'MLG Max Strength' CG-envelope boundary.

pct_load_nlg_max.description: Maximum fraction of total aircraft weight the nose gear is rated to carry: sets the 'NLG Max Strength' CG-envelope boundary.

pct_load_nlg_max_handling.description: Maximum fraction of weight on the nose gear at the forward CG limit. Raymer 6th ed. Sec. 11.2: above 0.20 the main gear is too far aft (0.15 preferred); 0.05 is the same pair's aft-CG minimum.

pct_load_nlg_min.description: Minimum fraction of weight on the nose gear at the most-aft CG, setting the Min Nose Load CG boundary. Class value 0.0352: the lowest share at a certified most-aft CG in 13 airliner families.

propulsion_installation_factor.description: Legacy comparison only: multiplier on dry engine mass accounting for pylon, cowling, fire suppression and other installed accessories.

propulsion_mass_fallback_fraction.description: Legacy comparison only: fallback propulsion mass as a fraction of MTOW, used only if the selected engine isn't found in the database.

propulsion_twr_factor.description: Legacy comparison only: dry engine mass is estimated as thrust / (this factor * g). Historical engine thrust-to-weight ratios are ~5-7, so this factor is typically ~6.

suspended_mass_fraction.description: Legacy comparison only: fraction of MTOW treated as suspended mass in the Torenbeek wing structural formula [0-1]. Typical commercial transport 0.70-0.78.

systems_mass_fraction.description: Legacy comparison only: avionics, electrical, ECS, APU, etc. as a fraction of MTOW. Raymer Table 15.2: 9-13% for commercial transports.

enabled.description: Fly the design along the configured route in a normal Run, producing block fuel and trajectory figures.

great_circle_points.description: Number of points a great-circle route is sampled at when no airway or dispatched routing is available. Higher is smoother on the globe and costs nothing else.

max_airway_stretch.description: Reject generated airway detours above this ratio to great-circle distance (dimensionless) and use the great circle instead.

navdata_dir.description: Directory holding the navigation data the airway router reads. Downloaded on demand rather than distributed with the program.

plan.description: The mission as a list of stages (take-off, climbs, cruises, holds, descents, diversions, landing) with payload and fuel events. Empty flies the standard mission.

climb_descent_speed_reference.description: Whether the takeoff, climb, descent and landing airspeeds are true airspeeds (legacy default) or calibrated airspeeds resolved at each leg's altitude.

climb_mach.description: Mach held on the climb legs above the altitude where the calibrated airspeed schedule reaches it (the CAS/Mach crossover). Zero: constant calibrated airspeed all the way up.

cruise_1_air_speed_m_s.description: Airspeed flown on the first cruise leg.

cruise_1_distance_fraction.description: Relative share of the distance remaining after climb and descent legs flown on the first cruise leg. Active cruise fractions are normalized so the route closes exactly.

cruise_2_air_speed_m_s.description: Airspeed flown on the second cruise leg, slower than the first as the aircraft climbs and lightens.

cruise_2_distance_fraction.description: Relative share of the distance remaining after profile climb and descent legs flown on the second cruise leg.

cruise_3_air_speed_m_s.description: Airspeed flown on the third and final cruise leg.

cruise_3_distance_fraction.description: Relative share of the distance remaining after climb and descent legs flown on the third cruise leg. Active cruise fractions are normalized so the route closes exactly.

cruise_altitude_policy.description: Cruise level rule: declared altitude, design altitude, or optimum initial level (300 ft/min residual climb at top of climb) with step climbs.

descent_1_air_speed_m_s.description: Airspeed flown down to the first descent rung's altitude.

descent_1_altitude_ft.description: Altitude the first descent rung levels off at. A rung below the arrival field's elevation is skipped rather than flown.

descent_1_rate_m_s.description: Rate of descent flown down to the first rung's altitude.

descent_2_air_speed_m_s.description: Airspeed flown down to the second descent rung's altitude.

descent_2_altitude_ft.description: Altitude the second descent rung levels off at.

descent_2_rate_m_s.description: Rate of descent flown down to the second rung's altitude.

descent_3_air_speed_m_s.description: Airspeed flown down to the third descent rung's altitude.

descent_3_altitude_ft.description: Altitude the third descent rung levels off at, the usual speed-limit altitude below which airspeed is restricted.

descent_3_rate_m_s.description: Rate of descent flown down to the third rung's altitude.

descent_4_air_speed_m_s.description: Airspeed flown down to the fourth descent rung's altitude.

descent_4_altitude_ft.description: Altitude the fourth descent rung levels off at, where the approach begins.

descent_4_rate_m_s.description: Rate of descent flown down to the fourth rung's altitude.

descent_mach.description: Mach held on the descent legs above the CAS/Mach crossover altitude, with the calibrated airspeed schedule below it. Zero: constant calibrated airspeed from the top of descent.

initial_climb_air_speed_m_s.description: Airspeed flown from the end of the takeoff segment to the first cruise step.

initial_climb_altitude_fraction.description: Altitude the initial climb levels off at, as a fraction of the cruise altitude, so raising the cruise level moves this step up with it.

initial_climb_rate_m_s.description: Rate of climb flown up to the first cruise step. The steepest of the three climb segments, since the aircraft is at its lightest thrust-to-weight advantage low down.

landing_air_speed_m_s.description: Airspeed flown on the final descent to the arrival field's elevation: an approach speed, well below the descent rungs above it.

landing_descent_rate_m_s.description: Rate of descent flown on the final descent to the arrival field's elevation.

max_operating_cas_m_s.description: Maximum operating calibrated airspeed (VMO) from the type certificate data sheet [m/s]; no leg flies faster. Zero is undeclared (jet cruise is then held to VD / 1.25).

max_operating_mach.description: Maximum operating Mach number (MMO) from the type certificate data sheet. No climb or descent leg is flown above it and the cruise legs are held to it. Zero: not declared.

mmo_schedule.description: MMO from the type certificate data sheet where it varies with altitude: pairs of pressure altitude [m] and MMO, straight lines between rows, a step as two rows at one altitude. Replaces the single MMO when set.

step_climb_1_air_speed_m_s.description: Airspeed flown during the first step climb.

step_climb_1_altitude_fraction.description: Altitude the first step climb levels off at, as a fraction of the cruise altitude.

step_climb_1_rate_m_s.description: Rate of climb during the first step climb. Much shallower than the initial climb: the aircraft is heavy, high, and trading only a little altitude for cruise efficiency.

step_climb_2_air_speed_m_s.description: Airspeed flown during the second step climb, which reaches the final cruise altitude.

step_climb_2_rate_m_s.description: Rate of climb during the second step climb, the shallowest of the profile.

takeoff_air_speed_m_s.description: Airspeed flown from liftoff to the end of the takeoff segment.

takeoff_altitude_gain_m.description: Height above the departure field the takeoff segment climbs to before the initial climb takes over.

takeoff_climb_rate_m_s.description: Rate of climb flown during the takeoff segment.

takeoff_roll_time_s.description: Time from brake release to lift-off flown at take-off rating [s], added to the trip as a labelled fuel and time allowance.

vfe_landing_cas_m_s.description: Maximum flap-extended speed (VFE) of the landing flap from the type certificate data sheet [m/s calibrated]. The approach rung (descent 4) and the landing are flown at or below it, so the aircraft has slowed below VFE before the landing configuration is extended. Zero: not declared.

vmo_schedule.description: VMO from the type certificate data sheet where it varies with altitude: pairs of pressure altitude [m] and VMO [m/s calibrated], straight lines between rows, a step as two rows at one altitude. Replaces the single VMO when set.

route_distance_m.description: Still-air distance of the route this run planned [m].

routes_dir.description: Directory holding saved and imported route files.

simbrief_overrides_airports.description: If your latest SimBrief OFP is for a different city pair than the airports selected above, fly the OFP's pair instead (the most accurate route available).

simbrief_timeout_s.description: Time limit for fetching a filed flight plan before falling through to the other routing tiers. Set on Workspace > External Tools.

simbrief_username.description: Dispatch account name or pilot ID. When set, routing tries this account's latest flight plan before imported or great-circle routing. Blank skips it.

texture_path.description: Image the route globe is drawn on. Downloaded on demand rather than distributed with the program.

timeout_s.description: Not used: the mission analysis is not stopped by a time limit. Kept so existing configuration files still load.

use_airway_endpoint_coordinates.description: Read complete endpoints from coordinate-bearing airway data, including navaids absent from the fix catalog. Turn off with maximum airway stretch 0 to reproduce legacy routing.

alpha_sweep_halfwidth_deg.description: The MSES polar sweeps [trim_alpha - this, trim_alpha + this] so the comparison brackets the actual cruise operating point, not an arbitrary fixed range.

x-alas.label: Alpha sweep half-width around the trimmed design point

alpha_sweep_n_points.description: Number of angle-of-attack points in the MSES polar sweep.

enabled.description: Run an MSES 2-D polar sweep on the optimized root airfoil in a normal Run, filling the Model Comparison tab. On by default.

max_iterations.description: Newton iteration cap per angle of attack: MSES reports non-convergence rather than looping forever, but a hard cap keeps a single stubborn point from stalling the whole sweep.

mses_dir.description: Folder containing mset.exe, mses.exe and mplot.exe (absolute or repo-relative). MSES is licensed separately by MIT and is not distributed with ALAS.

mset_e.description: Streamwise grid stretching parameter for the MSET mesh: larger values cluster more points near the airfoil.

mset_n.description: Number of surface panel nodes MSET generates for the airfoil mesh.

mucon.description: MSES artificial-dissipation coefficient. 1.0 is its normal second-order setting; a negative value disables second-order dissipation and is reserved for legacy parity replay.

n_crit.description: e^N transition critical amplification factor (dimensionless). 9 is the standard clean-flight default (Drela); 4-5 gives earlier transition in rough environments.

osmap_path.description: Optional path to the double-precision osmapDP.dat used by MSES free-transition calculations.

timeout_mses_s.description: Max time allowed for one flow-solve (mses) call before it's killed.

timeout_mset_s.description: Max time allowed for one mesh-generation (mset) call before it's killed.

xtr_lower.description: Force transition at this lower-surface x/c. 1.0 = free (natural) transition.

xtr_upper.description: Force transition at this upper-surface x/c instead of letting MSES predict it. 1.0 = free (natural) transition, the realistic default for a clean cruise wing.

aircraft_class.description: Class of a clean-sheet brief: its design-variable guardrails. A registered aircraft keeps the class its preset declares.

engine_rating_window.description: Largest departure of the sized engine rating from the catalogue engine's, as a fraction of that rating, up to 0.6.

engine_sized_by_requirements.description: In clean-sheet mode, scale the catalogue engine to the smallest rating meeting every thrust requirement of the closed design.

fuselage_sized_by_cabin.description: In clean-sheet mode, set the fuselage length to the shortest one whose cabin seats the brief, instead of searching it with an integer seat-count step.

mode.description: Clean sheet moves every geometry variable inside its global bounds, sizes the fuselage from the cabin and scales the engine rating.

reference_angle_half_width_deg.description: Half-width of the search window around the reference sweep and tip twist.

reference_bump_half_width.description: Half-width of the search window around the reference Hicks-Henne bump amplitudes.

reference_fixed_variables.description: Comma-separated design-variable names that reference adaptation holds at the registered aircraft's values.

reference_fraction_half_width.description: Half-width of the search window around the reference value for spans, chords, fuselage length and scale factors, as a fraction of it. 0.10 moves a 34 m span 30.6-37.4 m.

reference_shift_half_width_m.description: Half-width of the search window around the reference wing and tail longitudinal positions.

aerodrome_reference_code.description: ICAO Annex 14 aerodrome code letter capping clean-sheet wingspan below the band edge (A 15 m, B 24 m, C 36 m, D 52 m, E 65 m, F 80 m). Auto picks it from the brief.

design_range_nmi.description: Still-air distance from takeoff to the intended destination flown by the design mission with the design payload [nmi].

kind.description: Used by the mission-sized differential_evolution profile. That profile sizes each candidate by the design mission and ranks it feasibility first.

max_approach_speed_kt.description: Upper bound on reference approach speed at maximum landing mass for the selected operating or aerodrome category [kt].

mtow_band_fraction.description: Half-width of the MTOW band as a fraction of the target: the search may pick any takeoff mass from target x (1 - f) to target x (1 + f).

mtow_sizing.description: How takeoff mass is set: fixed requirement, mission-iterated up to it or seeded by it, MTOW band around the target, or payload-adjusted with no ceiling.

mtow_target_kg.description: Centre of the MTOW band [kg]: the search starts at this takeoff mass and the band extends by the band fraction either side. Zero uses the requirement MTOW.

preference_weight.description: Dimensionless w in the ranking cost J = Q/Qref + w*P, where P sums normalized preference violations; an infeasible candidate adds 1 + H.

retrim_cg_tolerance_pct_mac.description: When takeoff mass is mission-sized, re-trim and re-evaluate the drag polar whenever the CG has moved more than this fraction of MAC since the last trim.

sizing_max_iterations.description: Maximum fixed-point passes of empty mass, fuel and takeoff mass before a candidate is reported as not closed. Transport closures normally settle in under ten passes.

sizing_tolerance_kg.description: Change in takeoff mass between two passes below which the sizing loop is taken as closed.

max_fuselage_fineness.description: Largest length over equivalent diameter (dimensionless). Transport fuselages sit near 8-12; the longest stretches reach about 14.

max_root_thickness_ratio.description: Largest root thickness as a fraction of root chord (dimensionless).

max_tail_arm_fraction.description: Largest tail arm as a fraction of fuselage length (dimensionless).

max_tip_root_chord_ratio.description: Largest tip chord divided by root chord (dimensionless).

max_tip_washout_deg.description: Least negative built washout accepted [deg], applied to the root-to-tip difference and every spanwise run.

min_aspect_ratio.description: Smallest b^2/S accepted (dimensionless), on projected reference span and area. Below this the lifting-line and wingbox correlations extrapolate.

min_fuselage_fineness.description: Smallest overall length divided by the largest equivalent cross-section diameter (dimensionless).

min_root_thickness_ratio.description: Smallest maximum section thickness at the wing root as a fraction of root chord, dimensionless. Below this the section carries no spar box the structural model can size.

min_tail_arm_fraction.description: Smallest wing quarter-chord to horizontal-tail quarter-chord distance divided by fuselage length (dimensionless, positive aft).

min_tip_root_chord_ratio.description: Smallest tip chord divided by root chord (dimensionless).

min_tip_washout_deg.description: Most negative built geometric washout accepted [deg]: built tip incidence minus root incidence (negative is washout). Registered aircraft run -4 to -7 deg.

constraint_tolerance.description: Unused: the SQP driver this setting configured has been removed. Retained so a configuration saved by an earlier build still loads with its value intact.

convergence_stagnation_generations.description: Refinement generations with best feasible objective improving by less than 1e-4 (relative) before the search stops as converged or stagnated.

finite_difference_step.description: Unused: the SQP driver this setting configured has been removed. Retained so a configuration saved by an earlier build still loads with its value intact.

method.description: The search that runs: mission-sized differential evolution (L-SHADE, epsilon constraints), seeded by a screening sample, with bounded feasibility restoration.

parameter_adaptation.description: Off: static F = 0.5 and CR = 0.9, better than adaptation below 800 evaluations per variable (Tanabe and Fukunaga 2020).

max_evaluations.description: Maximum analysed candidates in this stage; pre-gate rejections do not count. Time-limited refinement may plan a smaller budget.

max_pregate_rejects.description: Largest number of candidates the design-vector pre-gate may reject in this stage before it stops. Blank is 20 times the evaluation budget.

replay_planned_evaluations.description: Refinement only. Blank for a normal run.

replay_restoration_evaluations.description: Refinement only. Blank for a normal run or one without feasibility restoration.

time_limit_s.description: Elapsed-time limit [s], at most 300 s; checked between generations, so a running generation finishes. Ignored when stopping on evaluations only.

max_evaluations.description: Maximum analysed candidates in this stage; pre-gate rejections do not count. Time-limited refinement may plan a smaller budget.

max_pregate_rejects.description: Largest number of candidates the design-vector pre-gate may reject in this stage before it stops. Blank is 20 times the evaluation budget.

replay_planned_evaluations.description: Refinement only. Blank for a normal run.

replay_restoration_evaluations.description: Refinement only. Blank for a normal run or one without feasibility restoration.

time_limit_s.description: Elapsed-time limit [s], at most 300 s; checked between generations, so a running generation finishes. Ignored when stopping on evaluations only.

seed.description: Set an integer for a reproducible run (same seed -> same result); leave blank for a different search each run.

stop_on_evaluations_only.description: Off: each stage also stops at its time limit (result depends on machine speed).

tolerance.description: Normalized design-space spread (mean population range over bound width) below which a refinement that has stopped improving is reported as converged rather than stagnated.

workers.description: Threads a generation's candidates are spread across; 0 uses every thread the machine reports.

failure_cost.description: Cost returned for any candidate design that raises an exception or fails a hard guard during evaluation.

geometric_body_alpha_max_deg.description: Upper bound for the uncorrected geometric body angle of attack after force and moment trim at the nominated cruise point [deg].

geometric_body_alpha_min_deg.description: Lower bound for the uncorrected geometric body angle of attack after force and moment trim at the nominated cruise point [deg].

max_break_root_chord_ratio.description: Upper bound on break_chord_m / root_chord_m (dimensionless); real transports run about 0.45-0.65.

max_root_bending_box_slenderness.description: Upper bound on projected-span squared over root wingbox width times depth (dimensionless): a preliminary bending-capacity proxy, not wingbox sizing.

min_break_wingbox_depth_m.description: Minimum available structural depth at the kink station [m], from local airfoil thickness between the spars.

min_break_wingbox_width_m.description: Minimum front-to-rear spar separation at the kink station [m].

min_flap_area_fraction.description: Minimum physical trailing-edge flap area divided by wing planform area (dimensionless), from the flap chord and span run.

min_inboard_te_sweep_deg.description: Lowest admissible exposed side-of-body-to-kink trailing-edge sweep [deg].

min_root_wingbox_depth_m.description: Minimum available structural depth in the root spar box [m], from local airfoil thickness between the configured spars.

tankable_span_end_fraction.description: Outboard boundary of the wingbox interval credited as fuel volume, as a fraction of semispan.

tankable_span_start_fraction.description: Inboard boundary of the wingbox interval credited as fuel volume, as a fraction of semispan.

transport_planform_constraints_enabled.description: Apply consequence-based transport checks for geometric body angle of attack and usable wing-tank volume.

transport_shape_priors_enabled.description: Opt in to heuristic penalties on chord ratio, wingbox size, flap footprint, trailing-edge sweep and bending slenderness: airliner-shape preferences. Off by default.

bfl_factor.description: Additional historical multiplier used only by the legacy field path; the corrected jet TOP correlation ignores it.

cl_max_clean.description: Maximum lift coefficient in the clean configuration (flaps/slats up): the stall limit of the V-n diagram, distinct from the take-off and landing values.

cl_max_land.description: Maximum lift coefficient achievable in the landing flap/slat configuration. Drives landing distance.

cl_max_land_source.description: Reference for CLmax_land, including the published landing mass and approach speed when derived from an aircraft source.

cl_max_le_increment.description: Part of the take-off and landing CLmax increments given by the slats or Kruegers: slats out, flaps up, less clean. Geometry scaling moves it with the slat span and the sweep.

cl_max_to.description: Maximum lift coefficient achievable in the take-off flap/slat configuration. Drives take-off field length via the matching chart.

cl_min_clean.description: Most negative (inverted-flight) lift coefficient in clean configuration: the negative stall boundary on the V-n diagram.

cruise_thrust_from_deck.description: Judge cruise-altitude thrust requirements with the engine deck's thrust at cruise Mach and altitude instead of a flat lapse ratio. Off restores the flat ratio.

x-alas.label: Cruise thrust from the engine deck

engine_match_tolerance.description: Half-width of the accepted band for closed take-off mass over the take-off mass the engine was designed for.

geometry_scaled_clmax.description: During optimization, scale the declared clean, take-off and landing CLmax with the candidate wing sweep and flap area. Off keeps the declared values.

go_around_spool_thrust_fraction.description: Ratio of thrust available 8 s after advancing from flight idle (CS 25.119) to full go-around thrust. 1.0 is the non-conservative bound; about 0.95 is defensible.

improved_climb_v2.description: Raise take-off safety speed V2 above the schedule when needed to meet the CS 25.121(b) second-segment gradient, and charge the longer field. Jets only.

improved_climb_v2_over_vsr.description: Resolved improved-climb take-off safety speed over the reference stall speed. Written by the analysis, not a user input.

k_land.description: Empirical constant relating approach speed / wing loading to landing ground-roll + air distance.

landing_flap_deflection_deg.description: Largest certified landing flap deflection, from the aircraft's documents. Empty: the default of 35 deg applies.

landing_flap_delta_cd.description: Landing flap/slat drag increment on the reference wing area, gear retracted (14 CFR 25.121(d) approach climb).

landing_gear_delta_cd.description: Drag increment of the extended landing gear on the reference wing area in landing (approach, flare, 14 CFR 25.119).

legacy_field_correlations.description: Reproduce the translated jet correlation for every propulsion type, with its extra balanced-field multiplier and approach-speed factor.

main_gear_truck_wheels.description: Declared wheels per main-gear truck; selects the jet landing braking deceleration (Torenbeek): 0.40 g for two wheels, 0.32 g for four. 0 is treated as four.

matching_chart_resolution.description: Number of wing-loading points swept when drawing the matching-chart constraint curves. A plotting resolution only: higher is smoother but slower.

oei_asymmetric_trim_cd.description: Optional manual override of the asymmetric trim drag coefficient at V2 (reference wing area).

oei_climb_cl.description: Legacy constant lift coefficient for the conceptual one-engine-inoperative second-segment L/D (Raymer Ch. 17).

oei_climb_delta_cd.description: Take-off flap/slat drag increment on the reference wing area, gear retracted (14 CFR 25.121(b) configuration).

x-alas.label: OEI climb high-lift drag increment (gear up)

oei_condition_to_sls_thrust_ratio.description: Optional manual override of the installed thrust ratio (condition to SLS) for CS 25.121 engine-out checks. Empty takes it from the engine deck at V2.

x-alas.label: OEI thrust at V2 / rated SLS thrust

oei_gradient.description: Conceptual fallback gradient for an engine count outside the implemented 14 CFR 25.121(b) table.

oei_windmilling_cd.description: Optional manual override of the failed-engine drag coefficient at V2 (reference wing area).

propeller_dry_landing_distance_share.description: Share of available runway usable by the unfactored dry landing distance.

propeller_landing_deceleration_g.description: Mean dry-concrete landing deceleration divided by gravity.

propeller_landing_mean_drag_to_weight.description: Mean landing airborne drag minus thrust divided by weight.

propeller_takeoff_inertia_distance_m.description: Sea-level inertia-distance allowance in the preliminary balanced-field model.

propeller_takeoff_rolling_friction.description: Dry hard-runway rolling coefficient for the propeller takeoff calculation.

propeller_takeoff_stop_deceleration_g.description: Mean dry-runway reject deceleration divided by standard gravity.

takeoff_flap_deflection_deg.description: Trailing-edge flap deflection of the take-off setting, from the aircraft's documents. Empty: the default of 20 deg applies.

takeoff_gear_delta_cd.description: Drag increment of the extended landing gear on the reference wing area in take-off (14 CFR 25.121(a)). Default 0.020 (Roskam Part I, Table 3.6: 0.015-0.025).

thrust_lapse.description: Fraction by which static sea-level thrust falls off during the take-off ground roll / initial climb, used in the matching-chart take-off constraint.

v1_vr_factor.description: Decision speed V1 as a fraction of rotation speed VR. On a dry balanced field V1 sits just below VR (about 0.95-0.98).

v2_min_vsr_factor.description: CS 25.107(b): minimum take-off safety speed as a multiple of stall speed VSR: 1.13 for most turbojets and twin/tri turboprops, 1.08 for four-engine turboprops.

v2_vstall_factor.description: Selected take-off safety speed as a multiple of reference stall speed VSR.

vapp_vstall_land_factor.description: Approach-speed multiple retained for translated legacy results. The corrected method uses Vref = 1.23 VS1g, approximating the non-icing 14 CFR 25.125 VSR0 floor.

vmc_vstall_factor.description: Declared minimum-control speed as a multiple of take-off reference stall speed VSR.

vr_vmc_factor.description: FAR 25.107: rotation speed must be at least 1.05*VMC.

vr_vstall_factor.description: FAR 25.107: rotation speed must also be at least 1.10*VS_TO. VR = max(vr_vmc_factor*VMC, vr_vstall_factor*VS_TO).

vtd_vstall_land_factor.description: Touchdown speed as a multiple of landing stall speed.

wet_landing_runway.description: Apply the wet-runway landing distance factor: EU CAT.POL.A.235(a)(2) requires 115 % of the dry distance when no wet data exist. Off by default.

ws_max_pa.description: Upper wing-loading (W/S) axis limit on the matching chart plot. Widen for very heavy (freighter) aircraft. (~1020 kg/m^2)

ws_min_pa.description: Lower wing-loading (W/S) axis limit on the matching chart plot. Widen for very light (GA) aircraft. (~204 kg/m^2)

preset.description: Name of the aircraft preset this configuration started from, or blank for one built from defaults.

combustor_efficiency.description: Fraction of the fuel's heating value actually released as heat in the combustor.

combustor_pressure_ratio.description: Total-pressure loss fraction across the combustor.

core_nozzle_efficiency.description: Polytropic expansion efficiency of the core exhaust nozzle.

core_nozzle_pressure_ratio.description: Total pressure retained across the core exhaust nozzle.

cp_cold_j_kgk.description: Air-standard specific heat used for the inlet/fan/compressor (unburned-air) stations.

cp_hot_j_kgk.description: Combustion-gas specific heat used for the combustor/turbine/core-nozzle stations.

fan_nozzle_efficiency.description: Polytropic expansion efficiency of the fan (bypass) nozzle.

fan_nozzle_pressure_ratio.description: Total pressure retained across the fan (bypass) exhaust nozzle.

fan_polytropic_efficiency.description: Polytropic compression efficiency of the fan, which sets most of the thrust on a high-bypass engine and so matters more here than either compressor.

fuel_heating_value_kj_kg.description: Lower heating value of Jet-A/Jet-A1 fuel.

gamma_cold.description: Ratio of specific heats for the unburned-air stations, which sets how temperature rises with pressure through the inlet, fan and compressors.

gamma_hot.description: Ratio of specific heats for the combustion-gas stations. Lower than the cold-section value because the burned gas is hotter and its molecules have more ways to store energy.

hpc_polytropic_efficiency.description: Polytropic (small-stage) compression efficiency of the high-pressure compressor.

hpt_polytropic_efficiency.description: Polytropic (small-stage) expansion efficiency of the high-pressure turbine, which drives the high-pressure compressor.

inlet_pressure_recovery.description: Total-pressure recovery through the inlet (ram + duct losses). Matches the mission inlet_nozzle.pressure_ratio convention.

lpc_polytropic_efficiency.description: Polytropic (small-stage) compression efficiency of the low-pressure compressor. Lower values cost work at every stage and show up as higher fuel burn.

lpc_pressure_ratio_split.description: Fixed low-pressure-compressor (booster) pressure ratio; the high-pressure compressor supplies the rest of the overall pressure ratio (HPC = OPR / this).

lpt_polytropic_efficiency.description: Polytropic (small-stage) expansion efficiency of the low-pressure turbine, which drives the fan and the booster.

turbine_mechanical_efficiency.description: Shaft power-transmission efficiency for both spools (HPT-HPC, LPT-LPC+fan).

turboprop_overall_pressure_ratio.description: Overall core compression ratio for the free-turbine design cycle. The default is a conceptual design assumption, not certified engine data.

turboprop_turbine_inlet_temperature_k.description: Combustor-exit total temperature of the free-turbine design cycle [K].

aircraft_type.description: 'passenger' or 'cargo': switches which cabin-preset list and payload model apply.

cabin_preset.description: Named seating/payload layout preset (passenger: high-density, two-class, three-class; cargo: max or dense payload).

cargo_objective_kg.description: Cargo payload mass requested of a freighter, which the search is rewarded for approaching [kg].

cargo_payload_kg.description: Target cargo payload capacity (if aircraft_type is 'cargo'). Auto-recomputed when a cabin preset is active, only editable with cabin_preset set to 'Custom'.

cg_range_pct_mac.description: Width of the CG envelope. Forward CG Limit (%MAC) = Aft CG Limit (%MAC) - cg_range_pct_mac.

cruise_altitude_m.description: Design cruise altitude, used to compute air density/speed of sound for the cruise design point.

cruise_mach.description: Design cruise Mach number: the primary speed target the optimizer sizes the aircraft around.

dive_speed_m_s.description: Structural screening dive speed for the Torenbeek mass formulas and the V-n diagram.

gravity_m_s2.description: Standard gravity, used to turn every mass in the sizing into a weight. Configuration rather than a constant so a run's assumptions are all in one place and all visible.

initial_cruise_altitude_m.description: Optional requirement: the initial cruise level a jet must reach with a 300 ft/min residual climb at maximum-climb thrust. Empty: the achievable ICA is only reported.

initial_cruise_mass_kg.description: Brake-release mass the required initial cruise altitude is stated at. Empty: the maximum take-off weight.

limit_load_factor_neg.description: Negative V-n screening load factor (dimensionless). The shipped -1.0 follows the large-aeroplane CS-25 case up to VC; the positive limit is ultimate_load_factor / 1.5.

max_cruise_cl.description: Candidate designs whose required cruise CL exceeds this are rejected as infeasible (too close to stall).

max_wing_area_m2.description: Upper bound on the wing planform projected onto the aircraft XY reference plane; the optimizer is penalised for exceeding it.

min_passenger_capacity.description: Hard floor on the geometry-resolved passenger capacity: a candidate with fewer seats is infeasible. 0 disables it (default).

min_physical_static_margin.description: Minimum static margin at the actual mass-model CG (fraction of MAC).

min_wing_loading_kg_m2.description: Lower bound on wing loading (MTOW / wing area): keeps the wing from being sized too large for the mass it carries.

mtow_kg.description: Target maximum take-off weight: anchors the whole weight & balance / sizing pipeline.

num_passengers.description: Target passenger count (if aircraft_type is 'passenger'). Auto-recomputed when a cabin preset is active, only editable with cabin_preset set to 'Custom'.

passenger_mass_kg.description: Combined average mass per occupant, body plus baggage [kg]. The shipped 100 kg is a project load-case default, not an FAA AC 120-27F figure.

target_static_margin.description: Preferred static margin at the aerodynamic aft CG limit (fraction of MAC): aft limit [%MAC] = neutral point - target*100.

ultimate_load_factor.description: Structural screening input for the Torenbeek mass formulas (ultimate load factor, dimensionless).

ultimate_load_factor_from_mtow.description: Derive the ultimate load factor from the design MTOW by CS 25.337(b) and CS 25.303. Off uses the declared ultimate load factor.

additional_safety_factor.description: Extra margin multiplied onto the design loads on top of the CS-25 ultimate load factors (dimensionless). 1.0 means no extra margin beyond CS-25 ultimate.

cap_taper_eta_lock.description: Spanwise fraction below which spar caps keep their full root section (bending is highest inboard).

cap_taper_tip_fraction.description: Fraction of the locked-section cap flange width/thickness remaining at the wingtip.

center_spar_chord_fraction.description: Chordwise position of the optional center spar (see center_spar_enabled), as a fraction of local chord. Only used when center_spar_enabled is True.

center_spar_enabled.description: Adds an optional third spar from the root to the wing break, at center_spar_chord_fraction of chord: partial-span reinforcement where root load is highest.

enabled.description: Size a generic wingbox for the optimized wing, write NASTRAN .bdf files and compute theoretical deformations, stresses and frequencies in a normal Run.

freq_step_hz.description: Spacing between sweep frequencies. A step coarser than a mode's half-power bandwidth steps over the resonance without seeing it.

freq_sweep_max_hz.description: Highest frequency the sine sweep excites. Above the last mode of interest there is nothing left to find, and every extra step costs a solve.

lower_cover_fatigue_stress_1g_pa.description: Largest tensile stress of the lower wing cover in 1 g flight, set by service life [Pa].

max_linear_curvature_relative_error.description: Maximum relative curvature error from neglecting beam rotation, (1 + slope^2)^1.5 - 1.

mesh_chordwise_points.description: Number of chordwise points sampled per rib cross-section in the FEM mesh.

modal_damping_ratio.description: Structural damping assumed for the sine/random vibration response (2% is a common metallic-airframe assumption).

n_modes.description: Max structural modes for SOL 103's EIGRL and the analytical Rayleigh-quotient estimate.

nastran95_dir_path.description: Directory with build/bin/nastran and rf/NASINFO for the local NASA NASTRAN-95 adapter, independent of MSC NASTRAN.

nastran95_open_core_words.description: Optional NASTRAN-95 OCMEM allocation in words.

nastran95_rf_stage_path.description: Optional short absolute directory used to stage local NASTRAN-95 rf files. The 1970s RFOPEN loader accepts at most 37 bytes here; C:/nas-rf is suitable on Windows.

nastran95_runtime_path.description: Optional directory containing libgfortran and companion runtime DLLs for local NASTRAN-95. Leave blank when the runtime is already on PATH.

nastran_exe_path.description: Path to nastran.exe (absolute or repo-relative). Blank only writes .bdf files and uses the analytical estimates; no NASTRAN install is needed.

nastran_memory_mb.description: Estimate each solve's memory within this ceiling. Limits concurrent solvers instead of letting every process reserve half the host RAM. Increase for larger meshes.

nastran_solver_path.description: Optional absolute path to MSC analysis.exe, passed to the NASTRAN launcher as the a.solver keyword. Leave blank when the launcher finds its own solver.

num_ribs_override.description: Force an exact number of ribs instead of the auto-derived panel-buckling spacing. Leave blank to let the app determine rib count/spacing.

patran_exe_path.description: Path (repo-root-relative or absolute) to patran.exe. Leave blank to skip, no Patran install is required for anything else in Structural Analysis. Set on Workspace > External Tools.

psd_base_g2_per_hz.description: Frozen-reference acceleration PSD retained for saved-file compatibility. It is not used by the product RMS path, which requires the force PSD above.

x-alas.label: Legacy random vibration base PSD (not used)

random_force_psd_n2_per_hz.description: One-sided flat force PSD at the engine excitation grid [N^2/Hz].

rib_buckling_coeff.description: Empirical panel-buckling coefficient in the Euler skin-panel critical stress used to derive rib spacing (dimensionless): higher allows wider rib spacing.

rib_radius_of_gyration_m.description: Effective radius of gyration of a skin panel stiffened by a stringer, used by the same rib-spacing buckling formula.

run_nastran.description: Actually invoke nastran_exe_path on the generated .bdf files.

run_patran_export.description: After a successful SOL 101 static solve, replay a Patran session per load case to export a deformation-plot PNG.

run_sol_static.description: Pull-up / push-down / 1g-level static load cases -> deformation and stress.

run_sol_vibration_random.description: Integrate the solved unit-force SOL 111 response against the one-sided force PSD below, giving displacement RMS [m] over the frequency sweep.

run_sol_vibration_sine.description: Modal frequency response to a harmonic engine-mounted excitation force.

skin_material.description: Material name from the built-in structural material database, used for the wing skin panels.

spanwise_stations.description: Number of spanwise points for load, moment and deflection integration, wing-mass centroid integration and the analytical stress solver. Higher is smoother but slower.

spar_cap_material.description: Material for the spar caps (the primary bending-load-carrying members).

spar_chord_fractions.description: Chordwise position of each spar as a fraction of local chord (0 leading edge, 1 trailing edge), one entry per spar in any order.

spar_web_material.description: Material for the spar shear webs.

t_rib_m.description: Thickness of every rib web. Ribs carry no bending, so this is a fixed practical gauge rather than a sized quantity.

t_skin_min_m.description: Wing skin thickness actually used [m]. 6 mm matches a large long-range wing.

t_te_strip_m.description: Thickness of the panel running from the rear spar to the trailing edge on those ribs that carry one.

t_web_min_m.description: Floor on spar web thickness [m]. The web is sized for shear, which for a large wing falls below what can be manufactured, so this floor usually sets it.

te_rib_mode.description: Which ribs get trailing-edge panels to prevent TE buckling: 'all', 'none', 'alternate', 'inboard', 'outboard', or 'step_N' (every Nth rib).

timeout_s.description: Max time allowed for one NASTRAN solution (SOL 101/103/111 each run separately) before it's killed.

toda_override_m.description: Design take-off distance available for this case [m]. The requirement uses the shorter of this and the aerodrome's value, so it can only tighten it.
